buys.item: Chai from the stall at the Lodhi Road gate

answer.says: You are right, Mrs. Kapoor. I was about to retreat into my own thoughts, which is a form of cowardice when one is in the company of truth. I will sit. And I will listen. Please, tell me again, without the wince, what the mechanism actually is.
answer.thought: Her anger is a sign that she believes in the importance of what she is saying, which is more than can be said of most. I will sit and listen, not because I am afraid of her knees, but because I am curious about the reality she sees that I have been abstracting away. I will buy her a tea to show I am not merely passing through.
